description: Galbi, a quintessential Korean BBQ dish, features succulent beef short ribs marinated in a savory-sweet sauce and grilled to tender perfection. The rich marinade, often infused with fruit, tenderizes the meat and imparts an irresistible depth of flavor. This beloved Korean classic is perfect for gatherings, offering a delightful culinary experience.

instructions.title: Prepare the Short Ribs
instructions.text: Rinse the flanken-cut short ribs under cold water to remove any bone fragments. Pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels. If using thicker short ribs, butterfly them to ensure even cooking and better marinade penetration.

instructions.title: Make the Galbi Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, mirin, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, grated Asian pear (or kiwi), grated yellow onion, and chopped green onions. Whisk all ingredients together until the sugar is fully dissolved and the marinade is well combined.

instructions.title: Marinate the Ribs
instructions.text: Add the prepared short ribs to the bowl with the marinade, ensuring each piece is fully coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight (up to 24 hours), to allow the flavors to deeply penetrate the meat and tenderize it.

instructions.title: Prepare for Grilling
instructions.text: About 30 minutes before cooking, remove the marinated short ribs from the refrigerator to bring them closer to room temperature. This helps ensure more even cooking. Prepare your grill or a large cast-iron skillet for cooking.

instructions.title: Grill the Galbi
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (about 400°F / 200°C) or heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Lightly oil the grill grates or skillet. Cook the short ribs for 3-5 minutes per side, or until they are nicely caramelized with a slight char and cooked to your desired doneness. Adjust cooking time based on rib thickness.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Transfer the cooked Galbi to a serving platter. Garnish with fresh chopped green onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Serve immediately with steamed white rice, fresh lettuce leaves for wrapping, ssamjang (Korean dipping sauce), and various banchan (side dishes) for an authentic Korean BBQ experience.

tips: For ultimate tenderness and flavor, marinate the Galbi for at least 8 hours, or preferably overnight, allowing the fruit enzymes to tenderize the meat and the savory marinade to fully infuse.
When grilling, use tongs to flip the ribs frequently to prevent burning and ensure even caramelization. A slight char is desirable for authentic Korean BBQ flavor.
Serve Galbi with a variety of Korean side dishes like kimchi, pickled radishes, and bean sprout salad, along with fresh lettuce leaves to make ssam (wraps) for a complete meal.
